One of these missions is the Copernicus Polar Ice and Snow Topography Altimeter Mission , hereinafter referred to as well as CRISTAL. The primary high-level objectives are to monitor critical climate signals including: variability of Arctic and Southern Ocean sea-ice and its snow loading, as well as ice sheet, ice cap melting and sea level.
